name: semver-gate
description: Classify a candidate action as PATCH/MINOR/MAJOR (semver-style blast-radius test) before acting — act silently on PATCH, flag-and-stage MINOR, stop for explicit human sign-off on MAJOR. Use whenever you're mid-task and unsure how much autonomy to take on the next action: which of several implementation paths to pick, whether to overwrite unreviewed state, whether to disable a safety toggle, or any judgment call settings.json's autoMode patterns don't enumerate.
